description: This file defines API endpoints for a job portal backend using FastAPI. It includes routes for managing users, profiles, job postings, and applications, with role-based access control. The endpoints handle creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting resources, supporting search and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: create_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user (job seeker or employer). Checks for existing email, hashes password, creates user record, and initializes profile for job seekers.

methods.name: get_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves information of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: get_user(user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a user by ID, restricted to admin role.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: int, user: UserUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates user details; only self or admin can perform this.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.admin)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes a user account; restricted to admin.

methods.name: get_profile(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches a user's profile by user ID; public read-only access.

methods.name: update_profile( profile: ProfileUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows job seekers to update their own profile.

methods.name: create_job( job: JobCreate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows an employer to create a new job post.

methods.name: list_jobs( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Free-text search"), location: Optional[str] = None, remote: Optional[bool] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = Query(None, description="Filter by skills/tags"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Searches and filters available jobs based on query parameters.

methods.name: get_job(job_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a specific job by ID.

methods.name: update_job( job_id: int, job: JobUpdate, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Allows an employer or admin to update a job posting.

methods.name: delete_job( job_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes a specific job post; only employer who posted or admin can delete.

methods.name: create_application(app: ApplicationCreate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.job_seeker)))
methods.description: Job seekers submit applications to jobs.

methods.name: get_application(app_id: int, current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific application; access restricted to owner or employer.

methods.name: list_my_applications(current_user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all applications submitted by the current job seeker.

methods.name: update_application( app_id: int, update: ApplicationUpdate, current_user=Depends(require_role(Role.employer)), )
methods.description: Allows an employer to update the status or notes of an application.
